title: Wildlife Insights Detection Confidence Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wildlifeinsights:detection confidence_pct=*
| stats sum(confidence_pct) as total_value, avg(confidence_pct) as avg_value by species_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks species values by total and average confidence percent across Wildlife Insights detection events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `confidence_pct` values for each Wildlife Insights detection event and review total and average confidence percent by species.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total confidence percent.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts which species shows the biggest confidence percent numbers in your Wildlife Insights detection data.
